name: collection
description: The collection, redone: neon arcade glass over Van Gogh's Starry Night, and a New Tab page and sidebar of designed cards: a big clock with the weather in color, usage meters for every Claude and Codex account that count up when they change, and a chief gacha whose reel spins, slows and lands with a glow.

files.themes/last-demo-collection.json:
// Neon arcade: the collection's look, redone. Van Gogh's Starry Night under violet glass, a hot
// magenta accent with cyan and lime tones, card sections, and blocky but not boxy corners.
// Edit and save: the running app repaints at once, no relaunch.
{
  "name": "Neon Arcade",
  "description": "Starry Night under violet glass; hot magenta, cyan and lime.",

  "appearance.theme": "Synthwave",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#150f24",
    "foreground": "#f4ecff",
    "cursor": "#ff5fd2",
    "selection": "#7e6ba4",
    "accent": "#ff5fd2",
    "1": "#ff5c7a",
    "2": "#8cff9e",
    "3": "#ffd166",
    "4": "#5ce1ff",
    "5": "#ff5fd2",
    "6": "#5ce1ff"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "van-gogh-starry-night",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.74,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.4,

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "floating",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#0f0a1b",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.72,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",

  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#150f24",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.86,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#150f24",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.88,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#150f24",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.45,

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#ff5fd2",

  // Arcade blocks, softened: small radii everywhere, a tight strip, a narrower sidebar.
  "appearance.density": "compact",

  "ui.animationSpeed": "fast",

  // Shape, not only color (Leo: "customizing the tabs/sidebars a lot deeper"): arcade blocks: square 2 pt tabs and rows, a tight strip, a narrower 260 pt sidebar.
  "density": { "basedOn": "compact", "tokens": {"tabCornerRadius": 2, "tabCloseCornerRadius": 2, "verticalTabCornerRadius": 2, "sidebarCornerRadius": 2, "itemCornerRadius": 2, "tabGap": 3, "sidebarRowGap": 2, "sidebarWidth": 260 } },
  "window.titlebarButtons": "always",
  "agentPane.display.sessionInfo.placement": "overlay"
}
